name: TeleOCR (formerly NaviDC-OCR)
vendor: XingChen-AGI (China Telecom Xingchen Lab per secondary sources)

lineage.base_model: Qwen2.5-VL vision encoder + Qwen3 decoder (card: built upon Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3)
lineage.how_derived: four-stage training with pseudo-labels from multi-node consensus voting

purpose: Lightweight document parser that handles both digital and camera-captured (curved, crumpled, photographed) pages in one model without a dewarping step.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file of the model repo is the unmodified Apache License 2.0 text (Copyright 2026 China Telecom AI Technology Co., Ltd.); training-data terms not stated

architecture.kind: vision-language, Qwen2.5-VL style encoder + small Qwen3 decoder (secondary: 0.6B LM)
architecture.why_this_design: Geometry-aware modelling and content-structure decoupled learning so that photographed pages parse without rectification (card).

variants.repo: community GGUF (12 quantizations listed on the card)

engine_support.notes: only community GGUF builds; compatibility with llama.cpp mtmd unchecked

strengths: best listed score on photographed documents (Wild_OmniDocBench)
phone photos of paper without a separate dewarping model
weaknesses: Chinese and English only on the card
canonical repo moved and renamed (mirrors under other accounts exist)
best_for: photos of receipts, letters and pages taken with a phone

tona_fit.reason: best vendor numbers for camera captures, Apache-2.0 verified, but German unverified, no independent result and community-only GGUFs

pc-16gb.notes: BF16 about 2 GB; Tona runs one model at a time, so it replaces the resident model while it works
